data.title: Add statistics dashboard
data.body:
## Goal

Add a command to show aggregate statistics about bugs.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `docket stats` shows overall statistics
- [ ] Count by status: Draft, Approved, InProgress, Done, etc.
- [ ] Count by priority
- [ ] Average time to completion (if time tracking exists)
- [ ] Bugs completed this week/month
- [ ] Oldest open bugs
- [ ] `docket stats --json` for machine processing

## Context

Example output:
```
Docket Statistics
=================

By Status:
  Draft:      5
  Approved:  12
  InProgress: 3
  Done:      47
  NotPlanned: 2

By Priority:
  High:    8
  Medium: 51
  Low:    10

Activity:
  Created this week:   4
  Completed this week: 6
  Oldest open bug:     abc1 (45 days)
```

Lower priority: nice to have for larger projects.
